sloka: स तेन हरिसैन्येन सन्निकर्षं महायशाः।शीघ्रमागम्य रामाय दुःखितो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.८३.७ ।।
transliteration: sa tena harisainyena sannikarṣaṁ mahāyaśāḥ।śīghramāgamya rāmāya duḥkhito vākyamabravīt ।। 6.83.7 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman of great fame accompanied by army quickly came to Rama and submitted as follows.
